text: Initially, one must address the matter of pruning. This involves removing any unnecessary plant material that is not contributing to the health of the garden. To ensure productivity, we should avoid any unnecessary time spent on this process. Instead, we should focus on fundamental tasks such as fertilizing and watering. The second step involves the practice of watering. This is a crucial activity for maintaining a garden, as it helps to keep plants hydrated and healthy. One can accomplish this by utilizing a hose on hot days or a drip irrigation system to water their plants.
